title: This was a great tour
text:
A very nice tour, after the palace closes you can take a guided tour in small groups.
The guide Elena spoke with passion and with a lot of humor and knowledge.
author: O1279JPjand

title: Great tour
text: Excellent and fascinating tour with Elena.
author: 867simons

title: Hidden Gems
text: This was such a wonderful tour, which gave us an opportunity to see an amazingly beautiful part of Seville that we might otherwise have missed. Our guide, Rosa, was excellent, and we really enjoyed our morning with her.
author: Sharon_P

title: Angelia was well informed...
text: Angelia was well informed and we would have never gotten the history, details and stories of life in Seville at these times!!  We would highly recommend this tour  & ask for Angella!
author: brigid_h

title: Angela, our tour guide...
text: Angela, our tour guide was enthusiastic and very knowledgeable about the history of the sites we visited.  She replaced the original guide at the last minute and handled the tour with ease.
author: Michael_A

title: Our guide was...
text: Our guide was professionally trained. She had historical information as well as human interest stories about Seville's history.
author: Jeffrey_A

title: Wonderful guide!
text: Very interesting tour with our wonderful guide! As these palaces are less touristic it is so nice to take some time to walk around and hear all the stories about these palaces and the people who used to live there!
author: A_W

title: Secret palaces
text: Very good tour guide. Toured two palaces that are not widely visited in Seville as people still reside in parts of the palaces.  Enjoyed the tour and the guide very much.
author: John_R

title: Surprising palaces
text: Very nice tour with surprisingly beautiful palaces. Guide was fantastic and showed us several things in the streets of beautiful Seville. If we may make a comment: the private tour booked did not include entrance tickets (which surprised us!). So we had to purchase these separately in each palace.
author: dianamE2875LR

title: Lovely palaces
text: Nice morning tour. Guide picked us up at our hotel and we walked thru the Jewish quarter and learned the history on our way to the palace. Both were gorgeous and well worth visiting.
author: LisaDonley
